verdict.rationale: Nix is a package manager, so protections against malicious packages are a fair question for it. However, the evidence documents no switch to block install or lifecycle scripts and no minimum-release-age policy. Hermetic builds with declared dependencies and reproducible, hash-verifiable outputs are adjacent supply-chain properties, not the requested protections, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can turn on protections against malicious packages, such as blocking lifecycle scripts or enforcing a minimum release age
